messages:
Becca: Heads-up: Pilot cohort Alpha goes live next week (7/12-7/14). 6 customers. Goal: confirm SSO, embeddings flow, and collect a 72h "first impressions" signal. Need owners for invites, mini-survey, 48hr check, and a renewal-risk rule. Whos in?

Tom: Ill take invites + scheduling. Suggest 25m kickoff + 10m triage. Should we include a short pre-check script to reduce no-shows?

Huan: I can own the pre-check script & sandbox creds. Plan: 1) test login, 2) sample embed upload, 3) 1 query. Script will be copy/paste curl + one-liner for Windows.

Pri: Ill design the mini-survey (3 Qs) and the health-dashboard widget for CSMs. Short + mobile-first.

Ivy: Ops note  we should tag customers who request data residency or private deploy. Those are higher renewal risk if unmet. Can we add a field on the intake form?

Becca: Yes. Ivy pls add a "residency_required" flag. Also I want an automated SFDC rule: if first-week engagement < 30% -> set preview_risk = "engagement_low". If they request residency -> set preview_risk = "operational_concern".

Tom: Draft invite (short):
```
Subject: Redwood Preview Kickoff 
Hi <Name>,
Thanks for joining our preview. Pick a 35m slot to cover setup (SSO/API), run a quick test, and Q&A: <cal link>. Please run the pre-check before the call: <pre-check gist>.
Best,
Tom (CS)
```

Huan: Pre-check snippet (curl):
```
# pre-check: test login, embed upload, quick query
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/test-login -H "Authorization: Bearer <preview_key>"
# then upload small embed CSV
# then run sample query
curl -X POST https://api.redwood/v1/query -H "Authorization: Bearer <preview_key>" -d '{"input":"hello demo","max_tokens":20}'
```
Windows PS equivalent included in the drive.

Pri: Survey (3 Qs): 1) After the kickoff, how likely are you to advance this integration? (1-5) 2) Biggest blocker? (short free text) 3) Would you like an infra deep-dive? (Yes/No). Link: https://forms.gle/alpha-first72

Ivy: Intake field added: residency_required (Y/N), expected_data_volume (low/med/high), AM. Also added a "priority_ops" flag if they want private deploy.

Becca: Legal: can we collect aggregated telemetry for the preview? Need a consent sentence in the invite.

legal-bot: Recommended consent copy: "By participating in this preview you agree to the collection of aggregated telemetry for product improvement. No customer-identifiable data will be shared outside Redwood operations."

Tom: Will append consent to the invite and include a link to the privacy FAQ. Will post templates to /templates/preview-alpha.

Huan: Small ops question: if sample embed ingestion fails, what is the triage SLA? I propose 48 hours to fix or escalate.

Ivy: 48h SLA ok for preview. If a customer reports failure + residency_required -> escalate immediately to infra.

Pri: Health thresholds I propose for the dashboard: kickoff attended = yes/no; pre-check success = yes/no; survey score avg <3 => amber; any blocker flagged as "residency" or "private_deploy" => red and assign to AM.

Becca: Good. Also set up a Slack alert: when a customer becomes red, DM assigned AM and post to #cs-ops. Can we wire that?

Tom: calendar-bot created: Alpha Preview Kickoffs 7/12-7/14 (6 slots). If sent invites for three confirmed customers; remaining 3 pending.

Huan: Pre-check gist uploaded: https://gist.redwood/alpha-precheck. Will attach PS snippets and sample CSV.

Pri: Posted survey link in the kickoff follow-up template and added a 48hr reminder to AMs if survey not completed.

Becca: Thanks team. Quick sync tomorrow 9:30 PT to confirm slate of invites + SFDC rule. If anything blocks, ping me. :sparkles:
